name: SSC Towplane Robin
title: SSC TOWPLANE ROBIN MOD
description: This mod enhances the stock Robin DR400 aircraft in MSFS 2024, converting it into a functional towplane ideal for launching gliders. It has been tested for efficient aerotows, including the fully ballasted JS3-18 glider from a 1600-foot runway with no wind. This modification addresses the limitations of existing towplanes in the simulator, providing a more reliable launch mechanism for gliding enthusiasts.
